# Figure 1

```{r format abundance table}
abundance.table.raw <- read.table("./data/abundances.wo-chimera.tsv", sep = ",", header = T)
names(abundance.table.raw) <- c("lib", "tax", "abundance")
abundance.table.raw$tax[abundance.table.raw$tax == "" | is.na(abundance.table.raw$tax)] <- "chloroplasts"
abundance.table.raw <- abundance.table.raw %>%
  mutate(tax = gsub("_m[0-9]*", "", tax))

associations <- read.table("./data/contaminations.csv", sep = ",", header = F)
names(associations) <- c("tax", "type")
associations.unique <- unique(associations)

contaminations <- associations.unique %>%
  filter(type == "contamination")

abundance.table.filtered <- abundance.table.raw %>%
  filter(!tax %in% contaminations$tax)

singletons <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  group_by(tax) %>%
  filter(n_distinct(lib) == 1) %>%
  ungroup()

abundance.table.filtered <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  filter(!tax %in% singletons$tax)

abundance.table.final <- abundance.table.filtered %>%
  group_by(lib) %>%
  mutate(abundance = abundance / sum(abundance)) %>%
  ungroup()
```

```{r plot abundance data}
abundance.md <- abundance.table.final %>%
  merge(metadata, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library")

## MAP 

world <- map_data("world")

abundance.md$longitude <- as.numeric(abundance.md$longitude)
abundance.md$latitude <- as.numeric(abundance.md$latitude)

map.p <- ggplot() +
 geom_polygon(data=world, aes(x=long, y=lat, group=group) , fill="grey")+
  theme_bw() +
 theme(panel.grid.major=element_blank(), panel.grid.minor=element_blank(),
    panel.border=element_blank()) +
 theme(axis.title=element_blank(), 
    axis.text=element_blank(), 
    axis.ticks=element_blank()) +
 geom_point(data=abundance.md, aes(x=longitude, y=latitude, shape=environment), size=2) +   theme(legend.position="none")

ggsave(map.p, file="./plots/Fig1b_map.pdf", width=170, height=110, units="mm", limitsize=F)


## ABUNDANCE

symbiont.order <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira", "Rickettsiaceae", "Margulisbacteria", "Simkaniaceae", "Coxiellaceae", "Endozoicomonadaceae", "Terasakiellaceae", "Rhodobacteraceae", "Sphingomonadaceae", "Comamonadaceae", "Alcanivoracaceae1", "Marinobacteraceae", "Spongiibacteraceae", "Saccharospirillaceae", "Nitrincolaceae", "Burkholderiaceae", "Xanthomonadaceae", "Alteromonadaceae", "Gammaproteobacteria_bacterium_LS_SOB", "Salinisphaeraceae", "Pseudohongiellaceae", "Sutterellaceae", "Pseudoalteromonadaceae", "Halomonadaceae", "Vibrionaceae", "Methylophilaceae", "Colwelliaceae", "Idiomarinaceae", "Flavobacteriaceae", "Cyclobacteriaceae", "Spirosomaceae", "Babeliales")

        axis.title.x=element_blank()) +

        axis.title.y=element_blank())

ggsave(abundance.p, file="./plots/Fig1c_abundance.pdf", width=170, height=120, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Figure 4 

```{r format and plot genome stats and transcriptomics}
genome.stats <- read.csv("./data/genome.stats.csv", sep = ",", header = T)
genome.stats.hq <- genome.stats %>% filter(completeness >= 90, contamination < 5)

### Figure 4a

genomestats.p <- ggplot() +
  geom_point(data = genome.stats.hq, aes(x = gc, y = size, fill = symbiont), size = 4, pch = 21) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = rick.colors) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(genomestats.p, file="./plots/Fig4a_genomestats_rev.pdf", width=70, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)

### Figure 4b

cog.data <- read.csv("./data/cog_cats.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)
names(cog.data) <- c("genome","gene", "category")

cog.data <- cog.data %>%
  merge(genome.stats, by = "genome") %>%
  filter(completeness >= 90, contamination < 5)

cog.counts.all <- cog.data %>%
  select(genome, symbiont, category) %>%
  group_by(genome, category, symbiont) %>%
  summarise(count = n(), .groups = "drop")

cog.counts.wide <- cog.counts.all %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = category, values_from = count, values_fill = 0)

count.cols <- cog.counts.wide %>%
  select(-genome, -symbiont)

rownames(count.cols) <- cog.counts.wide$genome 

count.cols.rel <- count.cols / rowSums(count.cols)

bc.dist <- vegdist(count.cols.rel, method = "bray")

set.seed(4)

pcoa.res <- cmdscale(bc.dist, k = 2, eig = TRUE)
pcoa.var <- round(100 * pcoa.res$eig / sum(pcoa.res$eig[pcoa.res$eig > 0]), 1)
pcoa.df <- as.data.frame(pcoa.res$points)
colnames(pcoa.df) <- c("PCoA1", "PCoA2")
pcoa.df$genome <- rownames(count.cols.rel)
pcoa.df$symbiont <- cog.counts.wide$symbiont[match(pcoa.df$genome, cog.counts.wide$genome)]

cog.pcoa.p <- ggplot(pcoa.df, aes(x = PCoA1, y = PCoA2, color = symbiont)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rick.colors) +
  labs(x = paste0("PCoA1 (", pcoa.var[1], "%)"), y = paste0("PCoA2 (", pcoa.var[2], "%)")) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(cog.pcoa.p, file="./plots/Fig4b_cog_pcoa_rev.pdf", width=70, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)

adonis2(bc.dist ~ symbiont, data = cog.counts.wide, permutations = 999)
anosim(bc.dist, grouping = cog.counts.wide$symbiont, permutations = 999)

### Figure 4c

anvio.dir <- "./data/annotations/anvio_out"

all.files <- list.files(anvio.dir, pattern = "_modules\\.txt$", full.names = TRUE)
hq.pattern <- str_c(str_escape(hq.genomes), "_modules\\.txt$", collapse = "|")
hq.files <- all.files[str_detect(basename(all.files), hq.pattern)]

anvio.modules.combined <- map_dfr(hq.files, read_tsv)

anvio.modules.combined.anno <- anvio.modules.combined %>%
  select(genome_name, module, module_name, module_category, module_subcategory, pathwise_module_completeness) %>%
  rename("genome" = "genome_name") %>%
  left_join(genome.stats, by = "genome")

anvio.modules.presence.long <- anvio.modules.combined.anno %>%
  mutate(presence = as.integer(pathwise_module_completeness >= 0.5))

anvio.modules.presence.mat <- anvio.modules.presence.long %>%
  select(genome, module, presence) %>%
  distinct(genome, module, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = module, values_from = presence, values_fill = 0) %>%
  column_to_rownames("genome") %>%
  as.matrix()

meta.hq <- anvio.modules.combined.anno %>%
  distinct(genome, symbiont, site, haplotype, completeness, contamination, size, trna, gc) %>%
  filter(genome %in% rownames(anvio.modules.presence.mat)) %>%
  arrange(match(genome, rownames(anvio.modules.presence.mat)))

stopifnot(all(meta.hq$genome == rownames(anvio.modules.presence.mat)))

anvio.modules.jacc <- vegdist(anvio.modules.presence.mat, method = "jaccard", binary = TRUE)
anvio.modules.jacc.hc <- hclust(anvio.modules.jacc, method = "average")

stopifnot(length(anvio.modules.jacc.hc$labels) == nrow(anvio.modules.presence.mat))

symbiont.groups <- sort(unique(meta.hq$symbiont))

module.presence.by.group <- as.data.frame(anvio.modules.presence.mat) %>%
  rownames_to_column("genome") %>%
  pivot_longer(-genome, names_to = "module", values_to = "presence") %>%
  left_join(meta.hq %>% select(genome, symbiont), by = "genome") %>%
  group_by(symbiont, module) %>%
  summarise(pct_present = mean(presence) * 100, .groups = "drop")

module.lookup <- anvio.modules.combined.anno %>%
  distinct(module, module_name, module_category)

module.presence.wide <- module.presence.by.group %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = symbiont, values_from = pct_present, values_fill = 0) %>%
  left_join(module.lookup, by = "module") %>%
  select(module, module_name, module_category, all_of(symbiont.groups))

module.pattern <- module.presence.wide %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(
    n_groups_present = sum(c_across(all_of(symbiont.groups)) > 50),
    max_other_when_1  = if (n_groups_present == 1) {
      top <- symbiont.groups[which.max(c_across(all_of(symbiont.groups)))]
      max(c_across(all_of(symbiont.groups))[symbiont.groups != top])
    } else NA_real_
  ) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    pattern = case_when(
      n_groups_present == length(symbiont.groups) ~ "Core",
      n_groups_present %in% 2:3 ~ "Accessory",
      n_groups_present == 1 & max_other_when_1 <= 5    ~ "Unique",
      n_groups_present == 1 & max_other_when_1 > 5     ~ "Accessory",
      n_groups_present == 0 ~ "Absent everywhere (excluded)",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    )
  ) %>%
  distinct(module, .keep_all = TRUE)

domain.exclusive.mods <- module.pattern %>%
  filter(pattern %in% c("Core", "Accessory", "Unique")) %>%
  filter(
    str_detect(str_to_lower(module_name), "eukaryotes|archaea|animals|fungi|plants") &
    !str_detect(str_to_lower(module_name), "bacteria|prokaryotes")
  ) %>%
  select(module, module_name, module_category, pattern, all_of(symbiont.groups))

implausible.mods <- c(
  domain.exclusive.mods$module,
  "M00168",  # CAM, dark (plant-specific)
  "M00172",  # C4-dicarboxylic acid cycle (C4 photosynthesis, plant-specific)
  "M00169",  # CAM, dark (plant-specific)
  "M00173", # reductive tricabroxylic acid cycle (autotrophic carbon fixation)
  "M00166" # Reductive pentose phosphate cycle / Calvin cycle (autotrophic carbon fixation)
)

final.modules <- module.pattern %>%
  filter(pattern %in% c("Core", "Accessory", "Unique")) %>%
  filter(!module %in% implausible.mods) %>%
  filter(module_category != "Gene set") %>% 
  arrange(factor(pattern, levels = c("Core", "Accessory", "Unique")), module_category)

heat.mat <- anvio.modules.presence.mat[, final.modules$module]
stopifnot(identical(colnames(heat.mat), final.modules$module))

genome.labels <- meta.hq %>%
  distinct(genome, site, haplotype) %>%
  mutate(
    sample_id = str_extract(genome, "^[^.]+"),
    display_label = paste0(haplotype, " (", site, ") - ", sample_id)
  )
stopifnot(!anyDuplicated(genome.labels$display_label))

new.rownames <- genome.labels$display_label[match(rownames(heat.mat), genome.labels$genome)]
stopifnot(!anyNA(new.rownames))

row.anno <- data.frame(symbiont = meta.hq$symbiont[match(rownames(heat.mat), meta.hq$genome)])
rownames(row.anno) <- new.rownames

col.anno <- final.modules %>% select(module, pattern, module_category) %>% column_to_rownames("module")
col.anno <- col.anno[colnames(heat.mat), , drop = FALSE]

mod.labels <- paste0(final.modules$module, " – ", final.modules$module_name)

rownames(heat.mat) <- new.rownames
colnames(heat.mat) <- mod.labels
rownames(col.anno) <- mod.labels

stopifnot(length(anvio.modules.jacc.hc$labels) == nrow(heat.mat))

gap.positions <- c(
  sum(final.modules$pattern == "Core"),
  sum(final.modules$pattern %in% c("Core", "Accessory"))
)

heat.mat.t <- t(heat.mat)

module.heatmap.test.p <- pheatmap(
  heat.mat,
  cluster_rows = anvio.modules.jacc.hc,   
  cluster_cols = FALSE,
  treeheight_row = 0,                     
  treeheight_col = 0,
  gaps_col = gap.positions,               
  annotation_row = row.anno,              
  annotation_colors = list(
    symbiont = rick.colors,
    pattern  = c("Core" = "grey70", "Accessory" = "#f4a582", "Unique" = "#2166ac")),
  annotation_names_row = FALSE,
  annotation_names_col = FALSE,
  color = c("#f0f0f0", "#4d4d4d"),
  legend = FALSE,
  annotation_legend = FALSE,
  show_rownames = FALSE,
  show_colnames = FALSE,
  border_color = "white"
)

ggsave(module.heatmap.test.p, file="./plots/Fig4c.module.heatmap.pdf", width=120, height=130, units="mm", limitsize=F)

### Figure 4d

tpm <- read.csv("./data/atp.tpm.csv", sep =",")
gene.names <- read.csv("./data/gene.names.tsv", sep ="\t", header = FALSE)
names(gene.names) <- c("target_id", "abbrev", "gene_name")

tpm <- tpm %>%
  merge(gene.names, by = "target_id")

tpm.atp <- tpm %>%
  filter(str_detect(gene_name, "ATP synthase|ADP,ATP"))

tpm.atp <- tpm.atp %>%
  mutate(cat = if_else(str_detect(gene_name, regex("ADP", ignore_case = TRUE)), "ADP", "ATP")) %>%
  mutate(sym = "Grellia") %>%
    mutate(host = case_when(str_detect(lib, "TR") ~ "Hawaii", TRUE ~ "Vienna"))
 
atp.tpm.boxplot.p <- ggplot(tpm.atp) +
  geom_boxplot(aes(x = interaction(sym, host), y = tpm, fill = interaction(sym, host))) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Grellia.Hawaii" = "#4876ba", "Grellia.Vienna" = "#4876ba")) +
  facet_wrap(~ cat, ncol = 1) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")

ggsave(atp.tpm.boxplot.p, file="./plots/Fig4d_atp_tpm_rev.pdf", width=35, height=70, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Figure Supp 4

```{r distribution of ATP related genes}
atp <-  read.csv("./data/atp_adp.overview.tsv", sep = "\t", header = T)

genome.stats <- genome.stats %>%
  mutate(symbiont_haplotype_site = paste(symbiont, haplotype, site, sep = "_"))

atp <- atp %>%
  left_join(genome.stats, by = "genome") %>%
  filter(completeness >= 90, contamination < 5)

atp.pct <- atp %>%
  group_by(symbiont_haplotype_site, gene) %>%
  summarise(
    n_genomes_with_gene = n_distinct(genome),
    total_genomes = n_distinct(atp$genome[atp$symbiont_haplotype_site == unique(symbiont_haplotype_site)]),
    pct_genomes_with_gene = (n_genomes_with_gene / total_genomes) * 100,
    .groups = "drop")

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  mutate(gene_type = ifelse(grepl("synthase", gene, ignore.case = TRUE),
                            "Synthase", "Translocase"))

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  mutate(symbiont = str_extract(symbiont_haplotype_site, "^[^_]+"))

rickettsia.order <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira")

atp.pct <- atp.pct %>%
  arrange(match(symbiont, rickettsia.order)) %>% 
  mutate(symbiont_haplotype_site = factor(symbiont_haplotype_site, levels = unique(symbiont_haplotype_site)))

atp.adp.heatmap.p <- ggplot(subset(atp.pct, gene_type == "Translocase"), aes(x = symbiont_haplotype_site, y = gene, fill = pct_genomes_with_gene)) +
  geom_tile(color = "white") +
  geom_text(aes(label = round(pct_genomes_with_gene, 0)), size = 3) +
  scale_fill_gradient(low = "white", high = "steelblue", name = "% Genomes") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, hjust = 1))

ggsave(atp.adp.heatmap.p, file="./plots/FigS4_heatmap_atp_adp.pdf", width=180, height=210, units="mm", limitsize=F)
```

# Table Supp 4

```{r check Rickettsiales presence on different levels}
# Summarise EMIRGE assemblies

rickettsia.taxa <- c("Aquarickettsia", "Grellia", "Benwitzia", "Megaira")
rickettsia.assembled <- metadata %>%
  distinct(library) %>%
  rename(lib = library) %>%
  left_join(
    abundance.table.final %>%
      filter(tax %in% rickettsia.taxa & !is.na(tax)) %>%
      distinct(lib, tax) %>% 
      mutate(present = "yes"),
    by = "lib") %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = tax,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = "no") %>%
  mutate(across(all_of(rickettsia.taxa), ~replace_na(.x, "no"))) %>%
  select(lib, all_of(rickettsia.taxa))

rickettsia.assembled <- rickettsia.assembled %>%
  merge(lib.annotation, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library") %>%
  select(library_type_site, Aquarickettsia, Grellia, Benwitzia, Megaira) %>%
  rename(sample = library_type_site)

write_tsv(rickettsia.assembled, "./data/rickettsia.assembled.tsv")

# Summarise genome mapping

genome.mapping.out <- read.table("./data/reta-mapping.out.tsv", sep = "\t", header = F)
names(genome.mapping.out) <- c("lib", "genome", "mapped_genes", "all_genes")
genome.mapping.out <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  mutate(genome = sub("^[^.]+\\.", "", genome)) %>%
  mutate(genome = sub("\\.kallisto\\.out", "", genome)) 

genome.mapping.out <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  mutate(pct_mapped = (mapped_genes / all_genes) * 100)

genome.mapping.with_symbiont <- genome.mapping.out %>%
  left_join(genome.stats %>% select(genome, symbiont), by = "genome")

genome.mapping.summary <- genome.mapping.with_symbiont %>%
  group_by(lib, symbiont) %>%
  summarise(
    mean_pct_mapped = mean(pct_mapped, na.rm = TRUE),
    sd_pct_mapped = sd(pct_mapped, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_genomes = n(),
    .groups = "drop")

rickettsia.genome.mapped <- genome.mapping.summary %>%
  select(lib, symbiont, mean_pct_mapped) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = symbiont,
    values_from = mean_pct_mapped,
    values_fill = NA)

rickettsia.genome.mapped <- rickettsia.genome.mapped %>%
  merge(lib.annotation, by.x = "lib", by.y = "library") %>%
  select(library_type_site, Aquarickettsia, Grellia, Benwitzia, Megaira) %>%
  rename(sample = library_type_site)

write_tsv(rickettsia.genome.mapped, "./data/rickettsia.genome.mapped.tsv")
```
